title: PARGAR: Pilot-Aware Graph Attention for Sparse-Pilot Neural OFDM Receivers
abstract: arXiv:2611.06432v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reliable channel estimation and symbol detection in 5G New Radio (NR), as well as emerging 6G radio systems, rely on demodulation reference signals (DMRS). The density and placement of these pilots on the orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) time--frequency resource grid affect both receiver reliability and spectral efficiency. Sparse DMRS layouts increase the time--frequency distance between pilot observations and data resource elements (REs), which can make pilot information harder to exploit with purely local processing. This paper proposes \textbf{PARGAR (Pilot-Aware Graph Attention Receiver)}, a graph-attention neural receiver that represents the OFDM resource grid as a graph for bit detection. The graph combines local time--frequency edges with pilot-anchor links from data REs to selected pilot REs, and we further study a channel-scaled pilot-anchor rule based on approximate coherence time and coherence bandwidth. translated_title: PARGAR：面向稀疏导频神经OFDM接收机的导频感知图注意力机制
translated_abstract: 在5G新空口（NR）以及新兴的6G无线系统中，可靠的信道估计与符号检测依赖于解调参考信号（DMRS）。这些导频在正交频分复用（OFDM）时频资源网格上的密度和位置会同时影响接收机的可靠性与频谱效率。稀疏的DMRS布局会增大导频观测点与数据资源单元（RE）之间的时频距离，这可能使纯局部处理方式难以充分利用导频信息。本文提出了PARGAR（导频感知图注意力接收机），一种将OFDM资源网格表示为图以进行比特检测的图注意力神经接收机。该图将局部时频边与从数据RE指向选定导频RE的导频锚点连接相结合，并进一步研究了基于近似相干时间和相干带宽的信道尺度化导频锚点规则。
tldr: 本文提出PARGAR，一种导频感知的图注意力神经接收机，通过将OFDM资源网格建模为融合局部时频边与导频锚点连接的图，有效提升了稀疏导频配置下的比特检测性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PARGAR, a pilot-aware graph attention neural receiver that models the OFDM resource grid as a graph combining local time-frequency edges with pilot-anchor links, improving bit detection performance under sparse pilot configurations.
